notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.8 BETA
notes.content:
The game was updated to 0.9.8 beta version. Despite the fact that many bugs and problems have been solved, we have to make even more improvements. We ask you to understand this and enjoy the game. All the bugs and shortcomings you can share on our mail 
[h1]newvectorgaming@gmail.com [/h1]

Changes:

[list]
 [*] Changed the main font.
 [*] A new map has been added. (Winter)
 [*] A new system of economics.
 [*] Improved training.
 [*] Now the turrets do not sleep.
 [*] Several improvements in the graph.
 [*] Many bugs fixed.
 [*] The system of swimming is added.
 [*] Now it's not so difficult to pass the game.
 [*] There were temporary bugs for 0.9.8 (sound).
[/list]

It is important for us that our players know that we hear them. One day all problems will be solved! Have a good game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32146278/32ffb8c733fcb51c9daa0962203ccba740c5e474.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.7b
notes.content:
UPDATE 0.9.7b!

Changes:
-The damage of the weapon is lowered.
-Less and faster waves.
-New load (background).
-It replaced the ax.
-The system of ammo was changed.
-Achievements have appeared.
-The volume of background music is increased.
-It changed the mob attack interval.
-The speed of waves is reduced.
-The fortress's health was changed.
-Now, when reloading, there's no blur.
-Improved the turrets.
-Easy game.
-Fix of bugs.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32146278/bb6453a70fb065537c4a82731104ad7c75403188.png[/img]

notes.title: Basic first questions
notes.content:
[h1] We have prepared some initial questions [/h1]

[list]
    [*][b]Q1. What should I protect? [/b]
    [*]A1. Near the spawn player you must find the orange cube, which is the fortress.

    [*][b]Q2. The turret is aimed at the enemy, but does not fire. What should I do?[/b]
    [*]A2. You need to buy ammo for the turret.

    [*][b]Q3. The turret was gone.[/b]
    [*]A3. Do not forget to repair the turret.

    [*][b]Q4.  Where can I get ammo for my weapon? [/b]
    [*]A4.They appear every 5/7/10/15 minutes in the spawn of the player, depending on the difficulty level. Sometimes ammunition for a pistol, and sometimes for a machine gun sometimes drop out.

    [*][b]Q5. . How can I support the project?[/b]
    [*]A5. You can share the game with your friends. And also playing in our game do not forget to do Bug reports.
[/list]
